author: 5kO0
content: Phase 3c-finish dispatch: addressing fmt drift (3 files) + 12 residual pedantic sites. Order: (1) cargo fmt --all to clear drift; (2) per-site fixes per the dispatch's site table with per-site category choice; (3) cargo fmt --all again; (4) full evidence-floor verification. Hard scope: no public-API breaks, no Cargo.toml/generated/codegen edits, no cid.rs touch (3d's target), no new error variants, no clippy --fix. Default to allow+comment on wildcard_imports/too_many_lines/implicit_hasher (Phase 1 break landmines + SemVer).
